datasets.name: marketsim-grounding-data
datasets.description: xlsx。德国购车成人真实人口联合分布(约5000万, Destatis/Zensus2022/BBSR/MiD2023 合成, 40320单元, sheets: population_state/population_state_urban/population_joint) + KBA FZ10 月度品牌份额真值(2023-01..2026-05, 41月×13类, sheets: brand_ground_truth/brand_share_wide)。人群锚定用 population_joint；品牌基线与校验目标用 brand_ground_truth。
